faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment is 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III post at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an MA/ M.Phil in Psychology/ Clinical Psychology or MA/ M.Phil in Rehabilitation Psychology or Diploma in Rehabilitation Psychology or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 36,400 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Technical Support-III post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. How should I apply for this position?
faq.answer: You need to send your complete application along with required documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section on this page, labeled as "Official Notification PDF".
